what: Viasat runs satellite broadband and defence communications. It provides internet to aircraft, ships and remote homes, and sells secure communications and encryption to the American military.
customers: Airlines fitting in-flight wifi, shipping operators, remote households and the American defence establishment.
money: in-flight connectivity, maritime and fixed broadband
secure military communications, encryption and space systems
moat: Licensed spectrum and satellites already in orbit, plus defence contracts and security clearances that make the government business difficult to displace.
risks: $7.1B of debt against $1.7B of cash, the central problem for this company
Starlink is taking aviation and maritime customers with lower prices and better performance
opportunities: $588M of free cash flow at about 15 times cash flow
Analysts see about 67% upside, with 10 covering the stock
The defence business is growing and would be worth a substantial sum on its own
watch: In-flight connectivity aircraft installed and the pace of debt reduction.
